parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file sits in the infrastructure layer and handles only HTTP transport and framework wiring. These are all transport concerns that belong in infrastructure. The file contains no business rules: it does not validate order state transitions or calculate stock levels. The /pay, /pack, /ship, /deliver and /cancel routes only pass requests to controller methods. The health endpoint returns a fixed status and contains no domain logic. Nothing in the file belongs to the domain or application layers.
